summary: Frontend-only testing of PHASE 10A-REWORK Tahap 2 WhatsApp tabs (Templates, Broadcast, Webhook Health). Initially found CRITICAL runtime error 'Dialog is not defined' in TemplatesTab caused by missing Dialog import in WhatsAppIntegration.jsx. Applied minor fix (added import from @/components/ui/dialog). After fix, all 12 wa-tabs render, all 3 new tabs render with expected data-testids, dialog opens with all fields, broadcast graceful (no crash), webhook-health shows overall=ERROR (as expected with no API key), Muat Ulang refresh works, Provider + AI Agent tabs still render (no regression).

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: Dialog is not defined - missing import for Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter from @/components/ui/dialog. Caused white-screen error overlay when Templates tab was opened. Fixed by testing agent.

action_items: Verify the Dialog import fix applied by testing agent in /app/frontend/src/pages/WhatsAppIntegration.jsx is acceptable; consider adding an ESLint rule or CI check to catch unresolved JSX identifiers before shipping.
critical_code_review_comments: Missing Dialog import was a shipping-blocker regression on TemplatesTab; the same file uses several UI primitives, worth a lint-based safeguard.
WhatsAppIntegration.jsx is growing large (10+ tabs) - consider splitting each tab into its own file for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. No real templates were created; dialog was opened and closed without saving.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tahap 2 frontend tabs (Templates/Broadcast/Webhook Health) now render and behave gracefully with no live API key. Health overall badge shows ERROR as expected. Broadcast send without template does not crash. Dialog import fix was applied by testing agent - main agent should verify.
rca of the issue: TemplatesTab component references <Dialog>, <DialogContent>, <DialogHeader>, <DialogTitle>, <DialogDescription>, <DialogFooter> but WhatsAppIntegration.jsx did not import these from @/components/ui/dialog. React renderer threw ReferenceError when the tab mounted, triggering the RuntimeError overlay and preventing any child data-testid from mounting. Repro: login as super_admin -> /whatsapp -> click Templates tab. Mitigation: added `import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter } from '@/components/ui/dialog';` at top of file.
